annotations.title: UK sector staff up or down

description: Free, no API key. Returns, for one UK sector (SIC division), the share of paired companies whose reported staff number rose, fell or stayed the same between two filings about one year apart, with the net staff change, the median change, the number of paired companies, both periods and the as-of date. Coverage is companies that file staff numbers in both years. Micro and small companies often do not, so it is not all companies. Flat includes companies that report the same number every year, including 0 or 1 staff. Returns value null with a reason when a sector has fewer than 30 paired companies or no match. Each answer states its date and its source. Returns JSON with fields value, unit, pct_grew, pct_shrank, pct_flat, pct_flat_zero_or_one, n_flat_zero_or_one, net_change_staff, median_change_staff, sic_division, sector_label, n, n_paired, period, period_before, as_of, source, coverage_note, caveat, url, or value and reason. Counts and shares only. Indicator to verify, not advice.

sector.description: Optional. A word from the sector name. For example wholesale. Use sic_division when a word matches several sectors.

sic_division.description: Optional. UK SIC 2007 division, 2 digits. For example 41 for construction of buildings.
